newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MONDAY MIXED ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MONDAY MIXED ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed Monday's session mixed on major currencies, easier against the U.S. dollar but firmer on sterling and the mark.

"At one point the dollar lost ground to the U.S. dollar to 10.3750/3950 but towards the close someone was selling money on the interbank market so the Zimbabwe dollar recovered a little to its opening position," one foreign exchange dealer said.
At Monday's close, the local unit was quoted at 10.3700/3900 on the U.S. dollar from 10.3650/3850 late Friday and was also a tad easier on the rand at 2.2860/2930 from 2.2820/2630.
It firmed slightly to 16.2100/2490 on sterling from 16.2210/2630 and on the mark to 6.7770/7930 compared to 6.7810/7970.
